summary: Preserve RegExp constructor pattern/flag coercion and observable coercion order.

target.notes: After IsRegExp classification, RegExpInitialize performs ToString(pattern) before ToString(flags); getters/toString hooks may run or throw.

caveats: IsRegExp itself may read Symbol.match before string coercion.

tests.name: coercion order
tests.input: const log=[]; const p={toString(){log.push('p');return 'a'}}; const f={toString(){log.push('f');return 'g'}}; new RegExp(p,f); console.log(log.join(','));
